items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: The minimum order is 1 kg of coffee. For larger offices, we recommend regular deliveries.
Simply fill out our online form or contact us by phone. We'll prepare a custom offer for you.
We accept bank transfer and invoice payments. Regular customers can opt for monthly billing.
We deliver throughout Slovakia. For Bratislava and surrounding areas, we provide our own delivery service.

items.q: How often can I receive coffee?
items.a: We offer monthly deliveries or delivery by agreement. You can change the frequency at any time.

items.q: What's the difference between Original and Gold Standard?
items.a: Original is our classic 100% Arabica blend with a full-bodied taste. Gold Standard is a premium select Arabica with a more delicate, complex flavor profile.

items.q: How long does the coffee stay fresh?
items.a: Coffee stays fresh for 6 weeks from roasting — that's the window when it tastes best. The roast date is printed on every package.

items.q: How should I store the coffee?
items.a: Keep in a dry, dark place in a sealed container. We don't recommend storing in the refrigerator.

items.q: Can I cancel my order anytime?
items.a: Of course. We have no long-term contracts. You can cancel or pause your order at any time.
